note.en: Her signature has the highest ATK% main stat of any W-Engine so far, tied for the highest Base ATK. It also buffs the team: higher Anomaly Proficiency means a stronger Refringe coefficient, and its 30% DMG bonus is always up. S5 is about 112%.

About 81%. An accessible free-to-play option and the best alternative, even compared to other agents' signatures. Its ATK% main stat helps her thresholds and its high Anomaly Proficiency is her only other stat need. It still falls far behind her signature.
